title: prangos thapsioides
intro: Prangos thapsioides, commonly known as Ferula, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant has been traditionally used in medicine due to its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ferula include its use as a digestive aid, a pain reliever, and a treatment for respiratory issues such as bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of Prangos thapsioides include alkaloids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
